operator_projection.unit: operator notifications per hour (ALARM + UNCLASSIFIED episodes)
operator_projection.basis: 20 episodes in 20.0 engine-h x 50 engines (SIM 2.1, soak_long engines 1300-1399 (unseen)); exact Poisson 95 % upper 72.7 per hour; guidance per operator ~6/h acceptable, ~12/h manageable. REAL carOBD held-out: 15.9 per hour (95 % upper 36.5), UNCLASSIFIED only
operator_projection.assumptions: 50 engines like the healthy test fleet (SIM 2.1 long soak, or the REAL carOBD held-out drives), independent, steady operation; every ALARM and every UNCLASSIFIED episode is one operator notification; ADVISORY is logged, not annunciated; nuisance load on a healthy fleet only (true fault alarms come on top); guidance: EEMUA 191 / ANSI/ISA-18.2 average alarm rate per operator (6/h acceptable, 12/h max manageable)

latency_ms.note: first true misfire -> ADVISORY window end, p 1.0, idle (the slowest band); median, p95 693 ms. mid 270, high 158, held-out rpm 123 ms. Live take: POST /inject -> ALARM 1090 ms (n = 1)
